buildCommand: pnpm --filter @pieai/university-core build && pnpm content && pnpm --filter @pieai/university-online... build

git.//: Pushing to GitHub must not deploy this site.
git.//2: The courses are not in this repository. apps/local/studies is 1.1G of source checkouts and apps/online/content is generated from them; both are gitignored, so a build that starts from a clone has nothing to import and produces an app with no courses in it. A deploy therefore has to run from a machine that holds the studies — `vercel build && vercel deploy --prebuilt` — which uploads the built output and never the source repositories.
git.//3: That also matches ADR-0002: publishing a course is a separate, gated act, not a side effect of pushing a commit.
